entries.title: Alluring Shadows — Zankou Banner
entries.description: Zankou opens Version 1.3 as the Phase 1 headliner — an Incantation/Gas Esper from the Scarlet Letter faction, featured on the Alluring Shadows board alongside A-rank Mint, Edgar and Adler.

entries.title: The Ichi-Daime — Nanally Rerun
entries.description: Rerun of Nanally's launch banner on The Ichi-daime board, running alongside Zankou's Phase 1 — see the Nanally guide for current build advice.

entries.title: Spellbound Special — Arc Banner
entries.description: The research program carrying Ravenous Blade, Zankou's signature Gas arc, alongside her Version 1.3 Phase 1 banner.

entries.title: Ready-Ready — Arc Banner
entries.description: Rerun of Nanally's signature Plasma arc, scaling off ATK% — available alongside her Phase 1 rerun banner.

entries.title: Surfing All Channels! — Linko Banner
entries.description: Linko opens Phase 2 of Version 1.3 as an Anima/Plasma Esper built around team-attack sync support.

entries.title: Misty Tipsy Style — Hotori Rerun
entries.description: Rerun of Hotori's Misty Tipsy Style board, running alongside Linko's Phase 2 banner — see the Hotori guide for current build advice.

entries.title: Chorus Special — Arc Banner
entries.description: The research program carrying Voice of the Voyager, Linko's signature Plasma arc, alongside her Version 1.3 Phase 2 banner.

entries.title: Waxing Circle — Beyond the Rails
entries.description: The third Version 1.2 rotation of the permanent Beyond the Rails anomaly mode, closing out the update.

entries.title: Circle Gifts
entries.description: A 7-day login check-in track for Version 1.3 — log in on 7 days inside the window to earn Solid Dice x10.

entries.title: Volley Star
entries.description: A new permanent Hethereau Hobby: 2v2 beach volleyball, paired with an AI partner through the Rookie Series group stage into a weekly ranked tournament.

entries.title: Surf Breaker
entries.description: Jetski racing across Hethereau's waterways — clear a route's three difficulties in order to unlock the next.

entries.title: Hunter's Crucible
entries.description: The Version 1.3 seasonal run of the boss-rush combat trial — clear a cumulative 15,000 points to unlock an exclusive event title.

entries.title: Alluring Perks — Alluring Shadows
entries.description: The Version 1.3 Phase 1 Perks pass, run alongside the Alluring Shadows board — adds the Scarlet Sash glider livery, the Sandy Mirage Sirocco vehicle livery and Zankou's Autumn Vignette outfit.

entries.title: Tiger Perks — The Ichi-daime
entries.description: The Perks pass attached to Nanally's Ichi-daime rerun — the Underboss-of-the-Underboss glider livery, the Tiger Incoming! M1000 livery and Nanally's Phoenix Kick outfit.

entries.title: Alluring Shadows — Special Offers
entries.description: The Phase 1 shop window: one-time dice, key and bond bundles for both the Alluring Shadows and Ichi-daime boards, plus a twice-buyable Anomaly Pilgrimage material box.

entries.title: Lucent Tides — Mystery Box
entries.description: A 15-box Fons/Annulith gacha whose cost climbs with every box opened — the pool holds the Tide watercraft, Nanally's Sunny Surf, Mint's Saltwater Taffy and Esper Zero's Cloudless Summer outfits. Opening all 15 clears the pool.

entries.title: Circle Bounty — Version 1.3
entries.description: The Version 1.3 season pass: run Circle Quests for XP, climb Circle Bounty ranks, and claim Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution and Expansion Cores — with Elite and Honor Hunter Supplies unlocking a paid reward track on top.

entries.title: Stamina Recharge
entries.description: A one-week Version 1.3 boost event: City Stamina spent in Hethereau Hobbies activities returns rewards at 2x efficiency.

entries.title: Beyond the Rails — Rotation (Aug 27)
entries.description: The first Version 1.3 rotation of Beyond the Rails, taking over from Waxing Circle on August 27 with its own weekly reward track.

entries.title: Shipwreck Salvage
entries.description: Ride the Tide jetski with a harpoon in hand to spear floating cargo marked on the map and haul it ashore before your fuel runs out — only cargo actually brought in counts.

entries.title: Gold Clash
entries.description: A two-week Version 1.3 boost event: Fons earned in Pink Paws Heist comes in at 2x efficiency for the whole window.

entries.title: Runaway Echoes
entries.description: A new mode entering Version 1.3: survive waves of monsters in an Anomalous Realm, leveling up mid-run to pick build-defining upgrade cards. Two variants — a timed Simulation Mode and an untimed Endless Mode.

entries.title: Beyond the Rails — Rotation (Sep 10)
entries.description: The Version 1.3 rotation of Beyond the Rails opening September 10, on the mode's standing 14-day cycle. Hotta names each circle as it goes live.

entries.title: Pixel Surge
entries.description: A one-week Version 1.3 boost event doubling Character Pixel rewards from eligible Anomaly Zone stages, capped at 120 Pixels per day.

entries.title: Breezy Tour
entries.description: Ride the 'Yesteryear' bicycle and invite a character along for the trip — they chat with your Appraiser as you pedal them to their destination.

entries.title: Fons Rush
entries.description: A closing Version 1.3 event doubling Fons earned from Hethereau Hobbies — Racing is excluded, and the bonus is capped once you've spent 700 City Stamina during the window.

entries.title: Beyond the Rails — Rotation (Sep 24)
entries.description: The Version 1.3 rotation of Beyond the Rails opening September 24. The mode refreshes on a 14-day cycle; Hotta names each circle as it goes live, so this one is unnamed for now.
